verse.text: This is my command—be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid or discouraged. For the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

video.title: Be Strong and Courageous | Christian Video Devotional

reflection: Leading a family well doesn't require having it all figured out—it requires showing up strong and courageous even when you're unsure, trusting that God goes with you into every hard conversation, every provider-pressure, every late-night worry. Your kids don't need a fearless dad; they need a dad who moves forward anyway because he knows Whose presence he carries. Let this verse be the quiet backbone behind today's decisions, big or small.
